test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If a sum on compound interest (compounded yearly) becomes three times in 4 years, then with the same interest rate, the sum will become 81 times in:
solution:
Given:

If a certain sum at compound interest becomes 3 times in 4 years

Formula used:

A = P(1 + r/100)t

Calculation:

Let the time be t.

We know that, 

Total Amount = P(1 + r/100)t

Now, according to question,

⇒ 3P = P(1 + r/100)4

⇒ 3 = (1 + r/100)4 ....(1)

Now,

After t years the sum becomes 81 times 

⇒ 81P = P(1 + r/100)t

⇒ 81 = (1 + r/100)t

⇒ 3⁴ = (1 + r/100)t

Using equation (1), we get

⇒ (1 + r/100)¹⁶ = (1 + r/100)t

⇒ t = 16 years

∴ The required time is 16 years.
